    def test_integration_zero_price_zero_quantity_discount_zero(self):
        calc = OrderCalculator()
        calc.add_item("Free", 0.0, 0)
        calc.add_item("Nominal", 0.0, 1)
        # subtotal 0, shipping cost 10, tax 0
        self.assertAlmostEqual(calc.calculate_total(), 10.0)

    def test_error_propagation_state_unchanged(self):
        calc = OrderCalculator()
        calc.add_item("Good", 10.0, 1)
        subtotal_before = calc.get_subtotal()
        # try invalid add
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            calc.add_item(123, 1.0, 1)
        # state unchanged
        self.assertAlmostEqual(calc.get_subtotal(), subtotal_before)
        self.assertEqual(calc.total_items(), 1)
